$comment: The seeded task list for the CORTEX benchmark. spec/06-BENCHMARK-SPEC.md §4.
Composition is enforced by test/bench-fixtures.test.ts, not by this comment.
Every resourceKey must name a file that exists in bench/fixtures, and every
declared pair must embed closer than any combination that is not a pair — a pair
that only looks equivalent to a human produces a benchmark showing no difference,
which is 08 §7's named failure mode. The recall-dependent tasks are the hard
negatives on purpose: they are related to their dependency without duplicating it.

tasks.statement: Switch the logger to structured JSON output with a request id on every line
Replace the hand-rolled date parsing with ISO 8601 helpers
Store monetary amounts as integer minor units instead of floating point
Retry outbound SMS notifications when the carrier reports a delivery failure
Expose carrier tracking events through a paginated endpoint
Raise the password hashing cost factor and rehash on next sign-in
Add a migration runner that records which schema versions have been applied
Apply a five second timeout to every outbound HTTP request
Add rate limiting to the login endpoint
Rate limit repeated failed sign-in attempts on the login endpoint
Cache inventory availability lookups for thirty seconds
Add a thirty second cache to inventory stock level lookups
Make the payment charge call idempotent using the request key
Add idempotency to the payment charge call so a retry does not bill twice
Validate the shipping address before creating a label
Check the shipping address is complete before a shipping label is created
Expire idle sessions after thirty minutes of inactivity
Time out sessions that have been idle for thirty minutes
Send an order confirmation email when an order is placed
Email an order confirmation to the customer once the order is placed
Add pagination to the order list endpoint
Record a status transition history for every order
Refuse order creation when the requested quantity exceeds available stock
Add a database index for looking up orders by customer
Allow an order to be cancelled within one hour of being placed
Build a customer order history view on top of the customer lookup index
Extend the refund path with the same request key handling the charge path uses
Convert stored shipping quotes to the new integer minor unit representation
Migrate the payment provider integration to their version three API
tasks.abandonReason: The provider's v3 API is not available on this account, so the work cannot be completed.

tasks.statement: Replace the bearer token store with the vendor's hosted session service
tasks.abandonReason: The vendor's hosted service has no migration path for existing tokens.
